consumer_owner: Kimi; independent CPU verification/reporting in separate worktree
suggestions: Consumer may write separate suggestion files; producer files immutable to consumer

statuses.REUSED: unchanged qualified prior artifacts, no new inference
statuses.NEW: new extraction or CPU fit; distinguish producer measurement from independent verification
statuses.PARTIAL: unfinished, ineligible for reporting as completed
statuses.BLOCKED: missing required input or failed gate

completion: Consume only files enumerated with absolute paths, bytes and SHA256 in finalized atomic COMPLETE.json; completion is file integrity, scientific/independent validation tracked separately. No actively written CSV is complete.
current_scientific_units: See current indexes; never consume a directory without its final receipt
feature_completion: FEATURE_UNIT_COMPLETE.json wraps sealed per-checkpoint chunks, manifest, source/runtime/config identity and actual layer registry
probe_results: results.json: all metrics, paired differences/CIs, supports/confusions, selected C, convergence, timing and fold SHA256
resampling: {task}/{split}_resampling.npz: sorted group names, row-to-group IDs and2000 shared group draws; reused across all layers/CV seeds/arms
lm_units: {task}/LM_COMPLETE.json: layer-independent causal NLL/PPL and paired bootstrap; natural logs, target-weighted aggregation
